title: An Exploration of Lacunary Orthogonal Polynomials Associated with the Geronimus Transformation
summary: In this note, we present two perturbations of sequences of orthogonal polynomials related to two iterations of the Geronimus transformation, with the feature that the resulting sequences of polynomials are missing a single degree. We relate these sequences to quasi-orthogonal polynomials of order 2 and investigate properties including recurrence relations, completeness, and associated differential equations.
